propositions: A custom verifier must be loadable via operator-configured import path (module:factory string) using importlib, validated against TokenVerifier protocol, and fail closed on invalid/unresolvable imports.
The current working directory must not be added to sys.path during import resolution, preventing cwd-based module hijacking.
Custom verifiers integrated into the composite must have their returned tokens subject to the mandatory audience re-check (resource field validation) per S2, preventing bypass of RFC 8707.
The auth_custom_import config field must be registered in McpConfig/_SECTIONS['mcp'] with a derived REBAR_MCP_AUTH_CUSTOM_IMPORT environment variable name in MCP_ENV_VARS and server.json.
